answer: A prism splits each work receipt in two. The public half joins a river of filings open to replay. The private half stays under an umber stamp. Each epoch an auditor demands one private half in ten minutes; a mismatch burns the 70-credit bond. The first receipt costs 42, the kth 42+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes owe 3,538,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. One half cannot serve two filings, so rented receipts fail. An honest agent pays 42 once.
